meta.title: Add event trigger source generator
meta.body_summary: Add a Roslyn source generator to replace reflection-based event wiring in EventTriggerBehavior with compile-time generated handlers.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex generated a source generator to replace reflection; bot review flagged correctness edge cases; PR was self-closed without merge after ~37h, no human review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 147 changed lines (81-line new generator, 47-line behavior change), this is a small-scale performance refactor by absolute volume. The PR was closed without merge by the author after bot review suggested edge-case bugs, consistent with a small but stagnated optimization attempt.

review_details.concern_detail: Copilot bot review flagged two issues: (1) zero-parameter events would throw at runtime due to `.Last()` on empty parameter list, and (2) static events are included and would generate invalid instance handlers.
review_details.performance_claim: Replace reflection-based event wiring with compile-time generated handlers for better performance.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR self-closed by author after bot review raised correctness issues; no human maintainer engagement.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Successfully structured a Roslyn incremental source generator to replace reflection but missed edge cases involving parameterless events and static events, indicating incomplete domain modeling of the C# event system.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance data; only a narrative claim of avoiding reflection overhead; testing instructions only `git status --short`.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed before any performance regression could be observed.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced EventGenerator/Roslyn incremental source generator that scans all types for events and generates handler methods in EventTriggerBehavior partial class. Replaced runtime reflection in EventTriggerBehavior.Attach/Detach with generated TryAddGeneratedHandler using switch expression.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Project and solution configuration files for the new source generator project.
change_trajectory: Single commit: Added EventGenerator project, source generator code, updated EventTriggerBehavior to use generated handlers, and registered the generator as an analyzer.

review_signals.summary: Generator uses invoke.Parameters.Last() without checking for zero-parameter events, which would throw. Add a guard for events with no parameters.
Generator includes static events that cannot be attached to instances; filter out static events (ev.AddMethod?.IsStatic) to avoid generating invalid handlers.
Copilot bot posted a PR Overview summarizing the change and reviewed all files, generating two inline comments regarding correctness and edge cases.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by author with one commit.
~20h later, Copilot bot reviewed with two inline correctness suggestions.
~37h after creation, author closed the PR without further activity.
